That differentiates it from the monthly report on existing home sales, which focuses on previously occupied homes. The data provides more details on the supply and demand situation for housing, while giving Wall Street and economists a glimpse into the market conditions for home builders and the related construction materials companies. Economists expect that the report will show a slight sales increase in August. That compares with the latest report on existing home sales for August, which showed a decrease. items.originalTitle: Google Prepares Project Suncatcher Satellite Launch To Test AI Chips In Space
items.originalSummary: Google LLC’s plan to put artificial intelligence data centers into low-Earth orbit is taking shape, as it prepares to launch its first satellite on a SpaceX Corp. rocket next week. In a blog post today, the company said Project Suncatcher will launch a prototype satellite into space in order to study how well its tensor processing units perform in the unique conditions of outer space. “This first launch is about seeing what works, identifying points of failure and applying those findings to future missions,” wrote Travis Beals, senior director of Google’s Paradigms of Intelligence research team. Google first announced Project Suncatcher in November 2025 in response to SpaceX founder Elon Musk’s own plans to launch space-based data centers for AI workloads. It’s the company’s effort to design orbital AI data centers that could potentially serve as a lower-cost alternative to ground-based facilities, which use enormous amounts of energy and water and have become increasingly contentious, with many people opposing their construction. The first Project Suncatcher satellite is expected to launch on Oct. 1, in order to validate the company’s vision of creating a constellation of AI satellites. Like SpaceX, Google wants to tap into the abundance of free solar energy available beyond Earth’s atmosphere in order to lower the costs of AI training and inference. Google’s first satellite is called MVP and it’s about the same size as a refrigerator. Inside it there are four of Google’s custom TPU accelerators, which are widely used here on Earth to train AI models and run inference on trained models. It’s a relatively small test. MVP will contain just four TPUs, and its solar panels will be able to generate only about a kilowatt of power, which is just enough to run a microwave or hair dryer. The TPUs are Google’s, but the satellite itself was developed by a company called Planet Labs PBC, which normally makes satellites for taking high-definition imagery of the Earth’s surface. MVP will launch as just one part of a wider payload aboard a SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket. Although this is really just an experiment, Google eventually plans to build a massive network of orbiting satellites that communicate with Earth using high-speed laser connections. If it gets that far, it will likely need to rent SpaceX’s rockets for dedicated launches. Next week’s launch aims to test a number of technologies that Google believes is critical for Project Suncatcher. For instance, Google needs to know how the TPUs themselves will perform in outer space after being subject to a violent 10-minute launch, where they will endure intense vibrations and forces up to 10 times stronger than Earth’s gravity. In addition, the company wants to see how its chips can handle the higher levels of radiation present in space that originate from cosmic rays and other solar events. This radiation could potentially damage the chip’s electronic circuit boards or corrupt data. The chips are expected to hold up. items.originalTitle: SpaceX Preps For 'Milestone' Starship Flight 14; NASA Updates ISS Mission Timing
items.originalSummary: SpaceX is due to launch its massive Starship rocket once again at the end of September. In a matter of days, the world's largest rocket could get off the ground for the 14th time since April 2023 from SpaceX's headquarters in South Texas. And this time, the commercial spaceflight company founded in 2002 by tech mogul Elon Musk has a crucial objective for Starship: reaching orbit for the first time . The milestone would mark a major accomplishment for SpaceX as it races to develop Starship for human spaceflight missions to both the moon and Mars . Musk also says the vehicle will be vital to SpaceX's plans to improve and expand its Starlink satellite network. As SpaceX works toward a Sept. 28 launch of Starship, here's a look back at Starship's path to what could be one of its most important test flights yet. SpaceX last launched its Starship rocket July 24 at its Starbase headquarters in South Texas , located about 23 miles from Brownsville near the U.S.-Mexico border. Powered by 33 of SpaceX's Raptor-class engines, the booster provided the initial burst of thrust at liftoff before separating from the upper stage minutes after launch and making a water landing in the Gulf of Mexico, renamed in the United States under executive order as the Gulf of America. While the booster was able to make a controlled landing, it was traveling faster than intended and made what the company later referred to as a "hard splashdown." The upper-stage had a much longer flight, using its own six Raptor engines to fly halfway around the world before landing in the Indian Ocean. Along the way, the vehicle successfully deployed 20 third-generation Starlink satellites, which communicated with the rest of the Starlink network before they burned up in Earth's atmosphere as intended. Significantly, the upper-stage, designated Ship 40, was able to slowly tip over and float in the ocean without exploding or sinking, as prior prototypes have done. That allowed SpaceX to haul the vehicle to shore near Australia and begin efforts to transport it all the way back to Starbase, Texas. SpaceX launched its Starship rocket for the first time in 2026 on May 22.

historyItems.title: 甲骨文尋求資料中心的「不可抗力」。為什麼它會導致股票下跌。
historyItems.summary: 根據彭博社報道，甲骨文正在向該專案的開發商（Blue Owl 的子公司）發送「不可抗力」通知，以保護自己免受與新墨西哥州大型資料中心專案相關的潛在成本增加的影響。甲骨文在給 CNBC 的聲明中表示：「木星計劃仍在我們的計劃中。」「我們完全致力於新墨西哥州，並對我們的前進道路充滿信心。」報道稱，如果該園區未能按預期在 2028 年上線，該公司將尋求延遲付款。 Blue Owl Capital 在給 CNBC 的聲明中表示，「該通知不會改變對該多年專案的財務承諾」。
historyItems.originalTitle: Oracle Seeks ‘Force Majeure’ on Data Center. Why It’s Sinking the Stock.
historyItems.originalSummary: Oracle is seeking to protect itself from potential cost increases related to a ​large data center project in New Mexico by sending a “force majeure” notice to the ‌project’s developer, a unit of Blue Owl according to a Bloomberg report. “Project Jupiter remains on our planned schedule,” Oracle said in a statement to CNBC. “We are fully committed to New Mexico and confident in our path forward.” According to the report, the company is looking to delay payment on the campus if it fails to come online as expected in 2028. “This notice does not change the financial commitments to this multi-year project,” Blue Owl Capital said in a statement to CNBC. Read: Oracle may cut more jobs as AI data center spending puts pressure on cash (September 12, 2026) The New Mexico data center is part of the broader Stargate artificial intelligence infrastructure build-out. However, it has faced several hurdles, including local opposition to data centers ahead of the upcoming midterm elections. Companies typically invoke force majeure to free themselves from contractual obligations when problems arise beyond their ​control, a move that can raise concerns among lenders and investors. “Force-majeure notices are commonplace in developments of this scale and are often used to preserve contractual rights among project partners. They do not, by themselves, establish a project delay or change delivery expectations,” ​Oracle added. According to media reports, the 1,400-acre Project Jupiter campus, which secured $18 billion in loans from a ‌consortium ⁠of banks is part of Oracle’s broader agreement with OpenAI to provide AI computing capacity. Oracle co-CEO Clay Magouyrk told analysts on the company’s earnings call on Sept. 10 that Project Jupiter would not affect its previously stated fiscal 2027 revenue or earnings guidance. Read: ‘Unable to log in’: After 12 years at Oracle, senior developer laid off (September 15, 2026)

historyItems.title: JPMorgan 初評 CRWV 至 Neutral
historyItems.summary: 摩根大通將 CoreWeave (CRWV) 上調至增持至 125 美元，但該股幾乎沒有變動，而 Nebius (NBIS) 因定價勢頭而飆升 6%。 Nebius 計劃於 10 月 1 日將 H100 至 B300 GPU 容量的價格上漲 17％ 至 21％，這是三個月內的第二次上漲。羅斯柴爾德 (Rothschild) 將目標定為中性，目標價為 40 美元後，IREN (IREN) 下跌 4%，顯示其 5 吉瓦電力基礎與實際人工智慧收入之間存在資本缺口。
historyItems.originalTitle: CoreWeave and Nebius Score Upgrades. Both Stocks Gain.
historyItems.originalSummary: JPMorgan upgraded CoreWeave (CRWV) to Overweight at $125, but the stock barely moved while Nebius (NBIS) surged 6% on pricing momentum. Nebius plans price hikes of 17 to 21 percent across H100 through B300 GPU capacity on Oct. 1, marking its second increase in three months. IREN (IREN) slid 4% after Rothschild initiated at Neutral with a $40 target, flagging the capital gap between its 5-gigawatt power base and actual AI revenue.

historyItems.originalTitle: Oracle Cites ‘Force Majeure’ to Shield Itself on Controversial Data Center
historyItems.originalSummary: Oracle is seeking to protect itself from potential cost increases related to a large data center project in New Mexico by sending a "force majeure" notice to developer Blue Owl, Bloomberg News reported on Thursday.Shares of the company fell around 4% in premarket trading after the report, which cited sources familiar with the matter. Reuters could not independently verify it.Oracle is aiming to delay payments should the data center dubbed Project Jupiter get derailed and fail to come online in 2028 as planned, rather than exiting as the main tenant, according to the report.Companies typically invoke force majeure to free themselves from contractual obligations when problems arise beyond their control. historyItems.originalTitle: Oracle stock drops as the company moves to shield itself from costs linked to controversial data center
historyItems.originalSummary: Oracle is seeking to protect itself from potential cost increases related to a ​large data center project in New Mexico by sending a “force majeure” notice to the ‌project’s developer, a unit of Blue Owl according to a Bloomberg report. “Project Jupiter remains on our planned schedule,” Oracle said in a statement to CNBC. “We are fully committed to New Mexico and confident in our path forward.” According to the report, the company is looking to delay payment on the campus if it fails to come online as expected in 2028. “This notice does not change the financial commitments to this multi-year project,” Blue Owl Capital said in a statement to CNBC. Read: Oracle may cut more jobs as AI data center spending puts pressure on cash (September 12, 2026) The New Mexico data center is part of the broader Stargate artificial intelligence infrastructure build-out. However, it has faced several hurdles, including local opposition to data centers ahead of the upcoming midterm elections. Companies typically invoke force majeure to free themselves from contractual obligations when problems arise beyond their ​control, a move that can raise concerns among lenders and investors. “Force-majeure notices are commonplace in developments of this scale and are often used to preserve contractual rights among project partners. They do not, by themselves, establish a project delay or change delivery expectations,” ​Oracle added. According to media reports, the 1,400-acre Project Jupiter campus, which secured $18 billion in loans from a ‌consortium ⁠of banks is part of Oracle’s broader agreement with OpenAI to provide AI computing capacity. Oracle co-CEO Clay Magouyrk told analysts on the company’s earnings call on Sept. 10 that Project Jupiter would not affect its previously stated fiscal 2027 revenue or earnings guidance. historyItems.title: AAOI 與 Fabrinet：哪隻人工智慧資料中心股票更值得買進？
historyItems.summary: Fabrinet FN 受益於人工智慧 (AI) 和雲端資料中心基礎設施不斷增長的需求。 2026財年第四季，資料中心營收達6.69億美元，年增68%，季增13%，佔總營收的51%。這一勢頭增強了 FN 在資料中心光學基礎設施領域的地位，以對抗應用光電公司 AAOI 和 Lumentum Holdings LITE，後者也受益於高速光學連接需求的不斷增長。 Fabrinet 的資料中心產品組合包括網路、資料中心互連 (DCI)、高效能運算 (HPC) 和其他人工智慧基礎架構應用。
historyItems.originalTitle: AAOI vs. Fabrinet: Which AI Data Center Stock Is the Better Buy?
historyItems.originalSummary: Fabrinet FN is benefiting from accelerating demand across artificial intelligence (AI) and cloud data-center infrastructure. In the fourth quarter of fiscal 2026, data center revenues reached $669 million, surging 68% year over year and 13% sequentially, and accounted for 51% of total revenues. This momentum strengthens FN's position in data-center optical infrastructure against Applied Optoelectronics AAOI and Lumentum Holdings LITE, which are also benefiting from rising demand for high-speed optical connectivity. Fabrinet's data center portfolio includes networking, data center interconnect (DCI), high-performance computing (HPC) and other AI infrastructure applications. DCI has emerged as a major growth engine for FN. It was the largest contributor to data center growth in the fourth quarter of fiscal 2026, with its annualized revenue run rate exceeding $1 billion. HPC contributed meaningfully as multiple programs with a major hyperscaler continued to ramp. Fabrinet is ramping the customer's next-generation silicon platform and installing additional capacity to support the technology transition and additional products. New transceiver wins are expected to strengthen this momentum further. Management expects a hyperscaler-direct program to ramp first, followed by a merchant program later in the year and additional programs expected to begin in early calendar 2027. Customers are providing visibility through the end of 2027 and beyond, although management noted that this visibility does not represent firm orders. Fabrinet is expanding capacity aggressively to support AI infrastructure demand. In the fourth quarter of fiscal 2026, Fabrinet said Building 10 in Chonburi is expected to add roughly $3-$3.5 billion of revenue capacity, increasing total capacity to $8.5-$9.3 billion. Including Nava Nakorn, the Santa Clara campus and two additional Chonburi facilities, management believes potential revenue capacity could eventually reach $12.5-$14 billion. The growing contribution from data centers is also improving Fabrinet's revenue mix. Data centAer products represented 47.9% of fiscal 2026 revenues, up from 46.2% in fiscal 2025, while total revenues increased 35.7% to $4.64 billion. Fabrinet is participating in next-generation optical architectures. The company is already working on co-packaged optics (CPO) with several customers and views near-packaged optics (NPO) as a potentially nearer-term opportunity.

historyItems.originalTitle: China surveys Broadcom switch use in state data centers, FT reports
historyItems.originalSummary: China Reviews Broadcom Switch Use in State Data Centres. China is reviewing the use of Broadcom switches in state-backed data centres as Beijing intensifies efforts to reduce dependence on foreign technology and promote domestic semiconductor and networking equipment suppliers, according to the Financial Times. The State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission (SASAC), which oversees China's state-owned enterprises, has reportedly surveyed companies in recent weeks to determine how extensively Broadcom equipment is deployed across their data centres. The review found that Broadcom switches may represent as much as 90% of the networking equipment used by some state-owned companies, the FT reported, citing a person familiar with the findings. The results could lead Chinese authorities to issue informal guidance encouraging companies to reduce their reliance on products supplied by the U.S. chipmaker. Broadcom, Nvidia and China's Huawei are among the major suppliers of high-performance switches used in Chinese data centres. However, state-backed facilities have already faced restrictions on the use of Nvidia products, according to the report. Any move targeting Broadcom equipment would mark another step in China's broader campaign to strengthen technological self-sufficiency amid ongoing tensions with the United States over semiconductors, artificial intelligence infrastructure and advanced computing technology. Beijing has increasingly promoted a "domestic chips for domestic use" strategy, encouraging state-controlled organizations and companies to adopt locally developed technology where possible. A reduction in Broadcom's presence at state-owned data centres could create additional opportunities for Chinese networking equipment manufacturers. Potential beneficiaries include Huawei, H3C Technologies and Shenzhen-listed Ruijie Networks, which compete in China's expanding market for data-centre infrastructure. The reported review does not necessarily mean China will impose a formal ban on Broadcom switches. However, informal procurement guidance could gradually shift spending toward domestic suppliers as Beijing seeks to build a technology ecosystem that is less dependent on U.S. companies. historyItems.originalTitle: GSME and Teradyne Announce Strategic Partnership
historyItems.originalSummary: Collaboration to Accelerate Semiconductor Test Solutions for Hyperscaler AI, Automotive, Silicon Photonics, and Next‑Generation DevicesSAN JOSE, Calif., Sept. 22, 2026 /CNW/ -- GS Microelectronics U.S., Inc. (GSME), a fast-growing semiconductor solutions provider, and Teradyne, Inc. (NASDAQ: TER), a leading provider of automated test equipment and advanced robotics, today announced a multi‑year strategic partnership to establish a state‑of‑the‑art semiconductor test and evaluation center designed to accelerate customer time‑to‑market. The collaboration integrates GSME's turnkey design and manufacturing enablement capabilities with Teradyne's industry‑leading automated test platforms, creating a high‑performance environment for device evaluation, engineering development, and production readiness. Under the agreement, GSME will operate a dedicated Teradyne‑equipped test floor and provide hands‑on engineering support for customers developing next‑generation devices across AI, silicon photonics, automotive, power management, RF technologies, and other emerging semiconductor applications.Key Highlights of the PartnershipState‑of‑the‑Art Test Center and InfrastructureGSME will deploy Teradyne's most advanced test systems within a dedicated test facility located at its new 42,000 square-foot Silicon Valley headquarters. The center will support customer demonstrations, device evaluations, engineering development, pilot production, and technical training, utilizing the latest test handlers and probers.Expanded Global Engineering SupportGSME is expanding its global team of highly qualified test engineers across the United States, Taiwan, Europe and the Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) region to support customers, design‑in engagements, test program development, and customer‑specific application requirements.Joint Customer Engagement GSME and Teradyne will collaborate through joint sales engagements, target account development, technical workshops, and customer briefings to accelerate Teradyne‑based design wins and broaden market adoption."This partnership marks a significant milestone for GSME and further strengthens our relationship with Teradyne," said Farhat Jahangir, President and CEO of GSME. "Standardizing on Teradyne's flagship test platforms enhances our custom silicon and manufacturing enablement services while giving customers a seamless pathway from device evaluation and test development to production readiness. By combining GSME's expertise in high-speed hyperscaler, analog and RF design, power management, manufacturing, and quality assurance with Teradyne's advanced test infrastructure, we are enabling customers to innovate faster and bring next‑generation products to market with confidence.""As semiconductor designs grow more complex, driven by AI data center buildouts, rapid access to high‑performance test development capabilities becomes essential," said Shannon Poulin, President of the Semiconductor Test Group at Teradyne. historyItems.originalTitle: Boeing unions to begin voting Thursday on latest contract offer
historyItems.originalSummary: The Society of Professional Engineering Employees in Aerospace (SPEEA) is encouraging its members to accept Boeing's latest contract proposal when they vote on the latest offer. On September 22, 2026, SPEEA's Bargaining Unit Councils (BUC) for professional and technical units said members should vote 'yes' to the agreement when the ballot opens on September 24, 2026, The two Bargaining Unit Councils said that the offers “meet most of the needs of the members”. Boeing presented its final proposal to SPEEA on September 11, 2026, following the conclusion of the latest round of negotiations. Boeing The new contract promises to increase wages and improve work lives and rebuild relationships between Boeing leadership and union members. "The union has won from Boeing gains for most priorities outlined at the outset of negotiations: market-leading compensation, benefits that matter, time to work and time to live, fairness and accountability, and workforce development," the BUC professional unit said. The BUC professional technical unit added: "Members are encouraged to examine both the advantages and limitations of the proposed agreement and determine whether it meets their expectations and priorities." On August 21, 2026, the majority of its SPEEA's Boeing union members rejected a new contract offer from the employer. Additionally voting members overwhelmingly supported SPEEA calling strike action if there were not “significant improvements to the offer”. The rejected four-year proposal was presented to around 13,000 engineers and scientists, as well as around 4,000 technical staff. Union members will have until October 4, 2026, to vote in the latest ballot. Highlighted improvements in Boeing's latest offer: A 10% Guaranteed Wage Increase (GWI) for all Prof and Tech unit-represented workers effective Oct. 16. Boeing will address concerns related to wage compression. The funds spent to address these concerns will be in addition to those identified in the contract offers. A 4% GWI for all Prof and Tech unit-represented workers during the annual compensation review in March 2027. 6% annual wage pools for 2028, 2029 and 2030, with each year having a 4% guaranteed increase for all. Revised language regarding work-from-home, overtime limits for Prof unit members and a new process for communicating Boeing’s future workforce needs to help SPEEA members plan their careers with the company A move back to our current three-bucket retention rating system. Carrying forward the gains from the first Boeing offer.

Recently, the GEK800 Serial Number 1 was tested at the X-58 test facility, igniting successfully. This achievement initiates a new testing campaign and demonstrates a 100 percent success rate for this critical phase of development, keeping the program on schedule. Recently designated the F143 and designed to meet the defined requirements of the Department of War for long-range, stand-off strike capabilities, the GEK800 represents a significant advancement in affordable, high-performance cruise missile technology. By leveraging modern engineering and cost-effective manufacturing processes, Kratos and GE Aerospace are positioned to deliver substantial capability and value to the warfighter. "The combined Kratos, GE Aerospace, and Government test team has demonstrated exceptional focus, discipline, and schedule execution," said Chris Rawlings, Vice President of Kratos' Defense Engine Portfolio. "This team sets the benchmark for operational efficiency and provides a refreshing reminder that our nation can develop turbine engines affordably and at pace." "With this latest milestone, the GEK800 engine continues to demonstrate strong performance and durability," said Jorge Perez, General Manager of Edison Works Advanced Combat Engines at GE Aerospace. "Our collaboration with Kratos is delivering a highly capable propulsion system designed to meet the demanding requirements of cruise missile applications." Delivering Capability to the Department of War and Industry Partners For the Department of War and allied defense prime contractors, the GEK800 provides a practical solution to the demand for rapid capability deployment and attritable strike assets. The successful test at X-58 validates the system's technological architecture, reliability, and readiness for integration. Kratos and GE Aerospace remain focused on providing cruise missile solutions that maintain performance while lowering lifecycle costs, enabling prime contractors to offer highly competitive missile solutions to government procurement programs. Stacey Rock, President of Kratos' Turbine Technologies Division, said, "Kratos continues to achieve milestones and accelerate program schedules as we prepare for large volume production of our GEK800 engine to support advanced cruise missile systems." historyItems.originalTitle: Better Artificial Intelligence Stock: Aehr Test Systems vs. KLA Corporation
historyItems.originalSummary: The race to power artificial intelligence creates opportunities for both hardware giants and niche companies. Choosing between Aehr Test Systems (NASDAQ:AEHR) and Super Micro Computer (NASDAQ:SMCI) depends on your specific risk tolerance. Hands Off the Arts organized a protest after Trump threatened to have the Kennedy Centre “ripped down” if his administration was not recognized for its contribution to the facility. A federal judge has ordered the centre to give 30 days’ notice before making major physical changes, including demolition. Trump has also tried to get his name on the building, but a judge ruled the centre cannot be renamed without congressional approval. The Trump-aligned board voted this week to shutter the venue indefinitely for repairs. Chris Raleigh, co-founder of Hands Off the Arts, said the protest was intended to show that people were willing to oppose Trump’s plans. “This may be the line that no one expected, but this is where the line is going to be,” he said, according to The Associated Press. historyItems.summary: 9 月 18 日，一系列新產品登陸全球 Apple 商店，其中以 iPhone 18 Pro 和 iPhone 18 Pro Max 為主角。蘋果全球行銷資深副總裁 Greg Joswiak 在發布新手機的新聞稿中表示：「透過 iPhone 18 Pro，我們在用戶最關心的領域取得了進步：相機、性能、電池和智慧。」作為產品發布會的一部分，該公司還推出了 Apple Watch Series 12、Apple Watch Ultra 4 和 AirPods 5，這是該公司還推出了 Apple Watch Series 12、Apple Watch Ultra 4 和 AirPods 5，這是該公司在新任首席執行長 John Ternus 的領導下首次推出此類產品的領導者。
historyItems.originalTitle: The latest iPhone, Apple Watch, and AirPods lineups arrive in stores worldwide
historyItems.originalSummary: A lineup of new products hit Apple stores worldwide on Sept. 18, headlined by the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max. “With iPhone 18 Pro, we’ve made advancements to the areas our users care about most: camera, performance, battery, and intelligence,” said Greg Joswiak, Apple’s senior vice president of Worldwide Marketing, in a news release announcing the new phones. The company also debuted the Apple Watch Series 12, the Apple Watch Ultra 4, and the AirPods 5 as part of the product launch—the company’s first such launch under its new CEO, John Ternus. Ternus, Joswiak, and senior vice president of retail Deirdre O’Brien led one of Friday’s launches at the Apple store on Fifth Avenue in New York City. The iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max are priced at $1,199 and $1,299, respectively, which is $100 more than the previous generation. The phones are available in the colors black, silver, glacier, and burgundy. Pre-orders began on Sept. 12.

historyItems.summary: NASA 斥資 9.46 億美元將太空探索技術公司（納斯達克股票代碼：SPCX）的載人國際太空站任務承諾延長至 2030 年，使合約總價值達到近 60 億美元。在此消息發布之前，財務長 Bret Johnsen 對公司到 2026 年底年收入運行率能夠達到 1000 億美元充滿信心，這個數字我覺得難以置信。我在先前對該股的報導中指出：SpaceX 稱 1,000 億美元觸手可及，其現金流卻講述了另一個故事。
historyItems.originalTitle: NASA Awards SpaceX Three Crew Flights to Space Station
historyItems.originalSummary: With a new $946 million, NASA has extended Space Exploration Technologies Corp.'s (NASDAQ: SPCX ) crewed ISS mission commitments through 2030, bringing the total contract value to nearly $6 billion. This news comes after CFO Bret Johnsen showed confidence that the company can reach $100 billion in annual revenue run rate by the end of 2026, a figure I find hard to believe. I pointed that out in my previous coverage of the stock: SpaceX Said $100 Billion Is Within Reach, Its Cash Flow Tells Another Story .

historyItems.summary: 隨著這家人工智慧雲端基礎設施公司繼續籌集資金以支持其擴張，CoreWeave 已將 2033 年到期的 2.875% 可轉換優先票據的私募發行規模擴大到 37 億美元，較先前宣布的 30 億美元有所增加。此次發行預計將於 2026 年 9 月 22 日完成，但須符合慣例成交條件。 CoreWeave 也授予初始購買者額外購買最多 5 億美元票據的選擇權，這可能會使發行總額增加到 42 億美元。這些票據的年利率為2.875%，從2027年4月1日開始每半年支付一次，並將於2033年4月1日到期，除非提前回購、贖回或轉換。
historyItems.originalTitle: CoreWeave launches $3 billion convertible debt sale
historyItems.originalSummary: CoreWeave has priced an upsized $3.7 billion private offering of 2.875% convertible senior notes due 2033, increasing the deal from the previously announced $3 billion as the AI cloud infrastructure company continues raising capital to support its expansion. The offering is expected to settle on September 22, 2026, subject to customary closing conditions. CoreWeave has also granted the initial purchasers an option to buy up to an additional $500 million of notes, potentially increasing the total offering to $4.2 billion. The notes will carry a 2.875% annual interest rate, payable semiannually beginning April 1, 2027, and will mature on April 1, 2033 unless they are repurchased, redeemed or converted earlier. The securities will be senior unsecured obligations of CoreWeave and will be guaranteed by wholly owned subsidiaries that also guarantee several of the company’s existing senior and convertible notes. CoreWeave expects net proceeds of approximately $3.64 billion after initial purchaser discounts and commissions but before estimated offering expenses. If purchasers exercise their additional $500 million option in full, net proceeds could increase to approximately $4.14 billion. Approximately $498.8 million of the proceeds will be used to fund capped call transactions designed to reduce potential dilution or offset certain cash payments if the notes are converted. The remaining proceeds are expected to be used for general corporate purposes. The notes initially convert at a rate of 10.2194 shares of CoreWeave Class A common stock per $1,000 principal amount, corresponding to an initial conversion price of approximately $97.85 per share. That represents a premium of approximately 22.5% over CoreWeave’s $79.88 closing price on September 17.

The new Antares and Radiant HALEU deals change the story, but they should not be your only focus. Check out 2 warning signs that Centrus Energy investors should know about. historyItems.title: Bloom Energy 的 800V 直流原生電源可節省 AI 資料中心數十億美元的成本、減少電力使用並消除對變壓器的需求
historyItems.summary: Bloom Energy Corporation（NYSE：BE）於 9 月 16 日推出全新 800V 直流原生燃料電池電源架構，旨在為下一代人工智慧資料中心提供持續直流電，吸引了投資者的廣泛關注。這些固態氧化物燃料電池本身可以產生連續的 800V 直流電，而不是產生交流電，然後必須將其轉換為人工智慧運算設備最終消耗的直流電。這可能會消除多個轉換級，例如變壓器和開關設備，從而降低資本成本和能源損失。
historyItems.originalTitle: Bloom Energy’s 800V DC-Native Power Can Cut Billions from AI Data Center Costs, Reduce Power Use, and Eliminate Need for Transformers
historyItems.originalSummary: Bloom Energy Corporation (NYSE: BE ) garnered significant investor attention after it unveiled a new 800V DC-native fuel-cell power architecture on September 16, designed to supply continuous direct current to the next generation of AI data centers. These solid-oxide fuel cells can generate continuous 800V DC power natively, rather than producing AC power that then has to be converted into DC that AI computing equipment ultimately consumes. This potentially removes several conversion stages, such as transformers and switchgear, thus lowering capital cost and energy losses. Bloom claims that its technology can cut non-compute capital expenditures for a 1 GW data center by $3.6 billion, or 27%, and lower five-year total cost of ownership by $5.5 billion, or 9%, compared to traditional AC-based infrastructure.
